**Yes.** Satellite data detected 0.6 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property in 2022. Of that area, approximately 0.5 hectares was mapped as native forest in Uruguay’s 2021 forest cartography; the remaining 0.1 hectares was outside mapped forest.

The entire loss area was mapped as forest in the JRC’s 2020 reference, and a later year was observed, meeting the tool’s corroboration rule. An additional 0.2 hectares of loss occurred in patches below the 0.5-hectare event threshold and was not counted as an event.
